+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source', ['runtime', 'config'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('request_url, blocked', [
+    ('https://example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://sub.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com./path', True),
+    ('https://otherexample.com/path', False),
+])
+def test_parent_domain_blocks_subdomains(
+    config_stub, host_blocker_factory, source, request_url, blocked
+):
+    """A blocked parent applies to its subdomains from either host set."""
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    hosts = (host_blocker._blocked_hosts if source == 'runtime'
+             else host_blocker._config_blocked_hosts)
+    hosts.add('example.com')
+
+    assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(request_url)) is blocked
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source', ['runtime', 'config'])
+def test_whitelisted_subdomain_overrides_blocked_parent(
+    config_stub, host_blocker_factory, source
+):
+    """An explicit URL whitelist wins over a parent-domain block."""
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = [
+        'https://sub.example.com/allowed']
+    host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    hosts = (host_blocker._blocked_hosts if source == 'runtime'
+             else host_blocker._config_blocked_hosts)
+    hosts.add('example.com')
+
+    assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://sub.example.com/allowed'))
+    assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://sub.example.com/denied'))
+
+
 def test_no_blocklist_update(config_stub, download_stub, host_blocker_factory):
     """Ensure no URL is blocked when no block list exists."""
     config_stub.val.content.blocking.hosts.lists = None
